statements.because: The download file-response path passes the request into the helper that performs the owner-aware check.
The lookup helper resolves the requested document to its root document before the authorization decision.
After a non-forbidden resolution, a later helper chooses the document whose file will be served.
The manual owner-aware authorization check requests view_document.
A failed owner-aware check returns HttpResponseForbidden and file selection is not reached.
The successful branch calls serve_file with the selected file document.
Whether the helper authorizes the user on the root document depends on has_perms_owner_aware.
Authentication backends, actual ownership, and object grants are runtime facts not fixed by this function.
